name: NeuroContent
author: NIA

sections.description:
NeuroContent AI transforms the way you create and publish content in WordPress.
Powered by OpenAI, it generates complete SEO-optimized articles and custom AI images — all with a single click.

Whether you run a blog, an affiliate website, an agency, or a large publication, NeuroContent AI helps you scale your content strategy effortlessly.

🚀 What NeuroContent AI Can Do for You

✓ Write full articles in seconds
From blog posts to product descriptions—just enter a prompt and the plugin writes the full article for you.

✓ Create custom AI images
Generate unique images directly inside WordPress: featured images, thumbnails, illustrations and more.

✓ Automate publishing with smart Triggers
Let the plugin publish content automatically:
every hour, daily, weekly, or on custom intervals.

✓ Boost your SEO
Generate keyword-rich content, structured headings, optimized paragraphs, and meta-friendly text.

✓ Eliminate workflow chaos
No more switching tabs or copy/pasting between tools.
Everything is done inside WordPress.

💡 Built for

  • Content creators & bloggers
  • SEO teams and digital agencies
  • News publishers
  • Affiliate sites
  • E-commerce owners
  • Anyone who needs high-quality content — fast

🎯 Why Teams Love NeuroContent AI

  • Clean UI built for speed
  • Native WordPress integration
  • Works with any theme or page builder
  • No coding required
  • Saves hours of writing and design work
  • Scales your content production at a fraction of the cost

NeuroContent AI isn’t just a content generator —
it’s your new publishing engine.
Create more. Publish faster. Grow smarter.

🔧 Core Features

⭐ AI Article Generation

  • Create complete SEO-optimized articles instantly.
  • Highly customizable prompts (tone, style, keywords, structure).

⭐ AI Image Creation

  • Generate unique images from prompts.
  • Useful for thumbnails, featured images, custom illustrations.

⭐ Scheduled Auto-Publishing (Triggers)

  • Fully automated content creation & publishing.
  • Hourly, daily, weekly, or custom schedules.

⭐ One-Click Article Generation

  • AI meta box inside Gutenberg & Classic Editor.
  • Generate text or images directly while editing a post.

⭐ Fully integrated into WordPress

  • Works with any theme.
  • Works with Gutenberg and Classic Editor.
  • Optimized for speed and ease of use.

External Services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API (api.openai.com) to generate text and images based on your prompts.

🔹 What service is used?

OpenAI API – https://api.openai.com
Used for:
– Text generation (articles, titles, summaries)
– Image generation

🔹 What data is sent and when?

Data is sent only when you click a “Generate” button or manually trigger AI creation.
The plugin sends:

  • Your text prompt
  • Optional content you choose to include (titles, descriptions)
  • Selected model and generation options
  • No personal user data is sent automatically

No background requests are made without user action.

🔹 Legal information

OpenAI Terms of Use
https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

OpenAI Privacy Policy
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

OpenAI may receive standard HTTP metadata (e.g. IP address) according to their policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Open NeuroContent AI in your WordPress Dashboard
  4. Add your OpenAI API key
  5. Start generating articles and images instantly
sections.faq:
What do I need to use the plugin?

You only need an OpenAI API key. Enter it in the plugin settings and you’re ready to generate content.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes, fully. NeuroContent AI adds a dedicated meta box directly inside the post editor.

Does it work with Classic Editor?

Yes, it integrates automatically without extra configuration.

Are articles unique?

Yes — each generation request produces unique content based on your prompt.

Can I automate content creation?

Yes. Using Triggers, the plugin can generate and publish articles automatically on a set schedule.
